booking.q: How do residents book a wash?
booking.a: They log in and choose a free time in the calendar for your laundry room. Available times are green, occupied ones are gray. Book with one click - and cancel again if plans change.

join.q: How does a resident get on board?
join.a: An administrator in the association invites the resident with a link. The resident creates their own account via the invitation.

mobile.a: Yes. LaundryBook runs directly in the browser on mobile, tablet and computer - no app to install. You can add a shortcut to your home screen if you want it to feel like an app.

pricing.q: How do we get our association on LaundryBook, and what does it cost?
pricing.a: Write to us at {{email}}, and we'll set up your association and tell you the price.

features.title: The laundry room shouldn't take up more space than it needs to
features.subtitle: LaundryBook solves one small but annoying part of living together: the laundry times. Here's how it works in practice:

booking.title: Like checking the weather forecast for the laundry room
booking.body: Available times are green, busy ones are yellow, occupied ones are gray. Pick a day of the week, find a time that suits you, book with one click. Done. Everyone in the association sees the same calendar at the same second.

administration.title: Set it up once. Then forget it.
administration.body: The board creates laundry rooms, time slots and lists of apartments. New residents are added by email. Old residents are removed again. Nothing more, nothing less.

overview.title: Figures for the general assembly
overview.body: How many washes per week? When's the rush? Is another laundry room needed? The numbers are there when you need them.

features.smallSectionTitle: More little things that make it easier

slots.title: Flexible time slots
slots.body: Define the length of laundry slots yourself - 90 min, 2 hours, evening slot until 22.

roles.title: Multiple roles
roles.body: Resident, property admin and system admin. Everyone sees what they should.

rooms.title: Multiple laundry rooms per property
rooms.body: Got two basements? No problem. Each gets its own calendar.

before.note: A note in the basement that disappears
before.noInsight: Nobody knows what the laundry room is actually used for

after.bookFromSofa: Book from the sofa, cancel when plans change
after.noDoubleBooking: No double bookings - the system doesn't allow it
after.boardInsight: The board sees patterns and can plan maintenance

about.title: It started four floors up
about.lead: Laundry times should be easy. Here's the problem we set out to solve.
about.story1: You know the feeling? You need to do laundry, but first you have to go all the way down to the basement to see if there's even a free time. Usually there isn't - the day is booked.
about.story2: You can't book from home. You have to stand in the basement to see the schedule and put your name down. And a busy everyday gets rearranged around the laundry schedule, because you discover too late that the whole day is taken.
about.story3: We experienced that problem ourselves - so that's why we built LaundryBook. A laundry booking you can check and use from home, so the trip to the basement is only about doing laundry.
about.honest1: LaundryBook does one thing and does it properly: laundry times. No superfluous features and no app to install - just a calendar everyone in the association can figure out.
about.honest2: Every new association is approved before it goes live. That keeps the system safe and clean, so you can trust the calendar to be accurate.
about.honest3: We keep building on LaundryBook all the time. If you have wishes or ideas, let us know - we're happy to listen.
about.factBrowser: Runs in the browser - no app to install
about.factAudience: For Danish homeowner and cooperative housing associations
about.factPrice: Price by agreement - write and ask
about.ctaBody: Try the demo without creating anything, or set up your association. If you have questions, write to us - we're happy to answer.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNotice: Draft - to be legally reviewed before LaundryBook goes live.
privacy.intro: How LaundryBook processes personal data. The policy explains what information we process, why, and what rights you have.

controller.heading: Data responsibility
controller.body: Your housing association is the data controller for the personal data processed in LaundryBook. LaundryBook is the data processor and only processes information according to the association's instructions and a data processing agreement.

data.heading: What information we process
data.body: We process your name, email address, possibly apartment number, as well as your bookings and your role in the association. Passwords are handled by our login provider and are not stored by us in plain text.

purpose.heading: Purpose
purpose.body: The information is used to provide access to the system, manage laundry bookings and send operational emails such as invitations and booking-related information.

legalBasis.heading: Legal basis
legalBasis.body: The processing takes place in order to provide the service to the association and its residents. [Insert final legal basis after legal review.]

subprocessors.heading: Sub-processors
subprocessors.body: We use selected suppliers for hosting, database, login and email delivery. Data is hosted in the EU. An updated list of sub-processors is provided to the association. [Insert list.]

retention.heading: Retention
retention.body: Information is stored as long as the association uses LaundryBook and your account is active. Upon deletion of the account or termination of the agreement, the information is deleted within [insert deadline].

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability. Requests regarding your rights should be directed to your association as data controller. You can complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency.

security.heading: Security
security.body: Data is transmitted encrypted (HTTPS), and access is controlled via roles, so residents only see their own association's information.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: We only use the cookies necessary to keep you logged in. [Updated if statistics or analytics tools are added.]

changes.heading: Changes
changes.body: We may update this privacy policy. Significant changes are notified to the association.

terms.title: Terms
terms.draftNotice: Draft - to be legally reviewed before LaundryBook goes live.
terms.intro: These terms apply to the use of LaundryBook.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using LaundryBook, you accept these terms. Read them through before you sign up.

service.heading: The service
service.body: LaundryBook is a digital booking system for laundry rooms in Danish homeowner and cooperative housing associations. The service is delivered via the browser, without an app.

signupApproval.heading: Sign-up and approval
signupApproval.body: Anyone can test the system, but an association is only activated once we have approved it. This ensures that only real associations are created with residents.

userResponsibility.heading: Your responsibility
userResponsibility.body: You are responsible for providing correct information, for activity on your account and for not misusing the system or bothering other residents.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.body: Price and payment for an active association are agreed separately with the association. [Insert final payment terms once the pricing model is set.]

availability.heading: Availability and liability
availability.body: We strive for high uptime, but the service is delivered as is, without a guarantee of uninterrupted operation. We are not liable for indirect losses. [To be specified legally.]

termination.heading: Termination
termination.body: The association can stop using LaundryBook at any time. Upon termination, access is closed, and data is processed as described in the privacy policy.
